actorReference.description: Lightweight external reference to who/what performed an action. Not a full Actor/Role/Authority Entity (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §13, existing Decision X: no Luvira OS Authority model imported).

humanActorReference.description: An actorReference constrained to actor_kind=HUMAN, for the specific points (Assessment finalization, Finding confirmation) where existing Decisions require human authority (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §10b, §14).
